decisions.reason: The glass flake spraying system extends the firm's established two-component technology into heavy corrosion protection, a market whose value is still unfolding, and carrying it costs little because it reuses existing platforms.

The low-pressure injection pump has its own page and a documented field application in construction repair, so the evidence points to a positive resolution of uncertainty and further commitment is justified.
The low-pressure transfer pump reuses the proven WIWA air motors, which keeps its carrying cost low while it rounds out the broad product range, so the option is worth holding.

Fire protection flow monitoring supports the firm's digitalization strategy and is consistently presented on its own page, and because its value is still uncertain at modest cost, keeping the option makes sense.
Launched only in 2024 and close to the firm's core hydraulic two-component offer, this system has had no time for its uncertainty to resolve and costs little to keep on the market.
